risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and quantitatively supported, including acquisition costs, accounting-estimate effects, tax payments, and identified operational exposures. Risk disclosures cover competition, supply-chain concentration, foreign exchange, COVID-19 uncertainty, and unresolved transfer-pricing audits, but rely at times on standard forward-looking and cross-referenced language. Overall tone is cautiously positive, reflecting strong demand and operational benefits while acknowledging material uncertainties.
